panasonic.V1_OCV: Exact degree-5 Chebyshev OCV from read-only unified Panasonic 2RC checkpoint; identified on source training windows, NOT an independent low-current OCV. User confirmed.
panasonic.z0_V1_V5: 1.0 for all profiles, as unified protocol; no target voltage inversion.
panasonic.soc: Canonical net Ah = negative raw Ah, offset at first retained sample; causal z0-net_Ah/2.9, clipped only in OCV evaluation.

calce.V1_OCV: SP1 independent 25C low-current discharge step 3, Q=2Ah, trapezoidal integration; same 0.002 SOC median bins and cumulative-maximum denoising as unified, PCHIP voltage(SOC), boundary hold at measured support.
calce.z0_V1_V5: Reuse each profile's documented causal initial SOC from read-only unified summary, with raw-file hash verification; no new target fitting.
calce.z0_V6_V7: Keep requested [0.9,1.0] even though SP2 80SOC source starts near 0.82. Transfer source-fitted z0 unchanged to all targets. User confirmed this incompatibility must be disclosed.
calce.soc: Step 7 only, canonical net Ah = Discharge_Capacity minus Charge_Capacity offset at first sample, preserving regeneration; no discharge-only counter or end normalization.

protocol.sampling: Both datasets linearly resampled to 1s to reuse unchanged LFP continuous simulator. Panasonic unified uses 0.1s; CALCE unified uses 1s.
protocol.current: Canonical positive discharge: negate raw Panasonic and CALCE charge-positive current.
protocol.simulator: Reuse exp_lfp_static.predict/unpack/bounds_starts and exp_lfp_gonogo.simulate/rc_voltage: exact ZOH 2RC, zero initial polarization, single continuous trajectory per profile.
protocol.fitting: All source samples only; three predetermined starts; minimum source squared residual among converged fits. V1/V5 fixed Q and documented per-profile z0; V6/V7 transfer fitted Q and z0 unchanged. V5/V7 degree-9 Chebyshev with unbounded coefficients.
protocol.shared_fit_settings: Exact bounds/starts from frozen lfp_static_protocol.json; verify equality to this protocol before fitting.

metrics.scopes: Full profile global, original causal SOC <20/20-80/>80%, 60s after reversals and intersections; identical masks across models.
metrics.source: Full source reference, not independent held-out evaluation.

decision.replication: Per dataset POSITIVA iff min(MAE_V5,MAE_V6,MAE_V7) <= 0.75*MAE_V1 on EVERY primary same-temperature target. Best model may differ per target. Secondary temperatures have no decision criterion.
decision.fractions: Report signed relative MAE reduction (V1-Vk)/V1 for each model. Oracle-ceiling fractions unavailable: no V4 authorized and no target refitting. User confirmed.
decision.thermal: POSITIVA iff at least 3 of 4 temperatures pass >=25% reduction against V1 in BOTH FUDS and US06 at that temperature.

protocol.unified_comparison: Read only results/unified/table_main.csv and summary.json; continuous MAE mean/std for ecm_2rc_nls, output_residual, ecm_ude. Same condition names and verified raw hashes. Explicit protocol differences: dt, exact ZOH versus RK4, degree9 versus degree5, full-source fitting versus guarded training windows, tau<=3600 versus10000, fixed SP1 OCV versus dynamic OCV, source full-profile versus validation mask. No training/checkpoint execution.

temperature_A123.cell: A1-007, same cell as previous A123 tests
temperature_A123.source_fits: Reuse read-only existing results/lfp_static/cell_A_a123 source-fitted V1/V5/V6/V7, with provenance verification; they were identified on DST25 under identical bounds.
temperature_A123.missing_policy: Stop this test without fitting or downloads. Save blocked manifest and exact required filenames. No thermal verdict and no substitution by another cell or temperature.

protocol.preservation: Hash every file in results/lfp_gonogo, results/lfp_static and results/unified before/after; never alter prior outputs or MANUSCRITO. New artifacts only in results/static_replication and results/lfp_static_temperature.

criterion: POSITIVA iff at least 3 of 4 temperatures pass >=25% reduction against V1 in BOTH FUDS and US06 at that temperature.
